history.result: Kept. The ending is now an embrace you can see: the two sit cheek to cheek on the bed and the last nine seconds are a mid over his shoulder on her face and a close on his eyes over her shoulder, both at eye level in the warm K5 light, instead of a high wide of the back of her head. Still drawings in the last 9 s: 77% -> 13% and 29%; the film's still share 0.45 -> 0.33. Honest limits: the motion is gentle (0.7, the weeping holds' rocking), not large; in the mid her face is half behind his head; the couple shift 7 units apart across the cut at 36.42 s (a cheat on the cut, not seen in shot).
